name: Iniquity
overview: Scripture reveals iniquity as a deeply ingrained condition affecting humanity from birth, as seen in Psalms 51:5 where David acknowledges being shaped in iniquity. It is a serious offense that God does not overlook, visiting the consequences of iniquity upon multiple generations (Exodus 34:7) and punishing it with discipline (Psalms 89:32). Yet, the Bible also emphasizes God's mercy and forgiveness when individuals confess their sins and iniquities, exemplified in Psalms 32:5. This calls believers to a posture of repentance and dependence on God’s grace, as suggested in Job 11:13 and Psalms 25:1.
